testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-account-sync.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-31722 user sales rep takes precedence over the account sales rep for visibility

scenario.summary: Account A has sales rep A; User 1 of account A (with an address, an order, a quote and a return) is overridden to sales rep B on Manage User. Rep A sees account A and its metrics but not User 1 or User 1's orders, quotes and returns; rep B sees User 1 and those records, and they count toward rep B's dashboard metrics.
steps: As admin: Accounts and Users > Users; open Manage User of User 1 (@overridden.userName); check its Sales Rep is @repA.fullName; select @repB.fullName in the Sales Rep lookup; save (precondition: User 1's rep manually overridden to rep B).
Sign in as sales rep A (@repA.userName, @repA.password); read the dashboard metrics (Total Accounts, Total Users, Total Orders, Total Quotes, Total Returns, Total Sales).
Rep A: Accounts and Users > Accounts, search @account.accountName and open its users; Accounts and Users > Users, search @overridden.userName.
Rep A: OMS > Orders search @order.orderNumber; OMS > Quotes search @quote.quoteNumber; OMS > Returns search @return.returnNumber; sign out.
Sign in as sales rep B (@repB.userName, @repB.password); read the dashboard metrics.
Rep B: Accounts and Users > Users search @overridden.userName; OMS > Orders search @order.orderNumber; OMS > Quotes search @quote.quoteNumber; OMS > Returns search @return.returnNumber.
stateChanges: Changes User 1's Sales Rep from @repA (taken from account A) to @repB on Manage User (User 1 and its records are deleted at teardown).
assertions: Before the override User 1's Sales Rep is @repA.fullName
Rep A: @account.accountName is listed in Accounts and the dashboard shows its metrics
Rep A: @overridden.userName is not listed in Users nor in account A's users (No records found. when searched)
Rep A: @order.orderNumber, @quote.quoteNumber and @return.returnNumber are not listed in Orders, Quotes and Returns
Rep B: @overridden.userName is listed in Users
Rep B: @order.orderNumber, @quote.quoteNumber and @return.returnNumber are listed in Orders, Quotes and Returns
Rep B: User 1's transactions count toward rep B's dashboard metrics
evidence: Story Z10-38546 (SalesRep - Phase 2, account association), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-38546/analysis.md sections 3-4 and answers in section 6.
Test case Z10-TC-31722 (AIO export): precondition, steps 1-4 and expected result.

FSD section 8 (effective Sales Rep: user rep > account rep, for dashboard, user, account and OMS visibility), section 11 (dashboard metrics only from records of the logged-in rep), section 12 (users reassigned to another rep are excluded from the account rep's listing), sections 13-14 (Users, OMS pages).

FSD (story Z10-38546) section 7: dashboard metrics, user listings, account-related user listings, orders, quotes, returns and other OMS entities of the user follow the effective user-level Sales Rep, so the records created before the override move with it to rep B.

Precondition 'User 1 overridden to rep B' is a UI step of the test on Manage User, as in Z10-TC-31717: USER_OF_ACCOUNT gets no rep param, because the account link in its create call takes the account's rep (FSD section 7 Important Point).

User 1's OMS records: ADDRESS_OF_USER (owner = @overridden.userId), then ORDER_OF_USER_REORDERABLE (simple product, quantity 1, no add-ons or personalization), QUOTE_OF_USER_CREATED and RETURN_OF_ORDER (order = @order.orderNumber), all created for User 1 through the API before the override.
Dashboard metric labels (Total Accounts, Total Users, Total Orders, Total Quotes, Total Returns, Total Sales: FSD section 11) are read from the page.
The sales rep signs in on the suite's admin URL with the password the SALES_REP_OF_STORE collection sets through the API (Phase 1 analysis answer 2).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A), as in the Phase 1 tests.
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
User 1's order is a simple in-stock product (ORDER_OF_USER_SIMPLE): the case needs any order of User 1; the reorder key always orders a configurable product with add-ons, which atstage does not have.

User 1's return is kept after the run (atstage never deletes a submitted return; user decision 2026-11-23). Its number comes from returnLookup (RETURN_NUMBER_OF_ORDER by the order number): the create response carries none.
